_comment: Apporo New API content profile for scripts/apporo_sync.py (docs/APPORO-SYNC.md). Source = WOOW production (read-only SQL); target = new-api-apporo (admin API). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_comment_price: Apporo's 30:1 rule: ModelRatio and ModelPrice are divided by 30 in float64 and stored exactly as rc.44 stores them. CompletionRatio, CacheRatio, CreateCacheRatio, GroupRatio and the display rate (CUSTOM / 32) stay WOOW's.
_comment_options: Apporo's own values. UserUsableGroups keeps WOOW's groups with these English labels; the currency symbol row does not exist at WOOW (it shows the default).
_comment_channels: Source channel id -> Apporo channel (same id unless target_id says otherwise, so abilities equal WOOW's rows for these ids). key_slot names a key of key_secret; set overrides copied fields.

excluded_channels.2: WOOW's internal ChatGPT subscription test route (group internal): not copied

_comment_platform: The Apporo platform's pricing check (woow_paas_platform services/llm_pricing.py): a change that would make it fail is alert-only.
